title: YunoHost's SOGo package trusts a spoofable header - any password logs you in as any user, admins too. 9 detections, 10 IOCs. Full analysis +
low_trust_reason: source reliability: AI-drafted aggregator reposts late and overstated (2026-09-27 digest incident)
content_md:
YunoHost's SOGo package trusts a spoofable header - any password logs you in as any user, admins too. 9 detections, 10 IOCs. Full analysis +

via Mastodon https://intel.threadlinqs.com/threat/TL-2026-2816

provenance.evidence: NVD CVE-2026-74864 (published 2026-09-30): sogo_ynh forces requests with x-webobjects-remote-user to be treated as verified without password validation; Nginx does not strip the header, so any client gains access as any user; fixed in 5.8.0~ynh9.
